headlines.text: That Saturday in 2021, a new chapter began as FTR vs. The Lucha Brothers fought for the brand-new AAA World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.28. A mystery-team angle ? FTR disguised themselves as masked luchadores "Las Super Ranas" to challenge the champions, unmasking mid-match, a fun swerve that ended with them capturing the AAA World Tag Team Championship for the very first time.

It was 2024 when Shelton Benjamin made their first appearance under the AEW banner against Lio Rush, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.34 ? a solid showing. Making his AEW in-ring debut in San Jose, Shelton Benjamin showed he hadn't lost a step, defeating Lio Rush just weeks ahead of Full Gear.

Rewind to 2019, when Chris Jericho vs. Darby Allin settled things in a Philadelphia Street Fight match, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.41 ? a well-worked match in a hard-fought men's division clash.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2024, when Mercedes Mone vs. Queen Aminata went to battle over the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.53. Queen Aminata was challenging for gold for the very first time. Mercedes Mone was chasing gold for the 10th time. Mon? submitted Aminata with the Statement Maker to retain the TBS Championship in a rematch that carried real tension after their heated WrestleDream confrontation.
